items.title: User Tracking Web Portal
items.description: A web application for tracking user activities (location point), having real-time updates and interactive maps. Portal contains reporting features, with personalized dashboards and analytics. Users can perform some actions related to uploading and managing its data.

items.title: User Tracking Mobile Application
items.description: Cross-platform application made in Flutter for tracking user activities with secure authentication, real-time updates, and interactive maps. Users can upload and manage their location data.

items.title: Primesys User Backend System
items.description: Spring boot Application, Updating Features and managing and updating code for primesys. Changing APIs endpoints and improving performance. Learnt a big deal of location and geographic directions while tracking users location activities.
